Summary stats mean_val <- mean(x_vals_non_na) sd_val <- sd(x_vals_non_na) nepal_value <- df |> filter(`Country Name` == "Nepal") |> pull(.data[[v]]) |> first() # Detect whether values are effectively integers is_integerish <- length(x_vals_non_na) > 0 && all(abs(x_vals_non_na - round(x_vals_non_na)) < 1e-8) # Choose histogram settings automatically if (is_integerish && diff(range(x_vals_non_na)) <= 50) { hist_geom <- geom_histogram( binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5, color = "gray40", fill = "gray80", na.rm = TRUE ) } else { # Freedman-Diaconis rule for continuous variables iqr_val <- IQR(x_vals_non_na) n_val <- length(x_vals_non_na) fd_binwidth <- 2 * iqr_val / (n_val^(1 / 3)) fd_binwidth <- 0.5 * fd_binwidth # Fallback if IQR is zero or binwidth is not usable if (!is.finite(fd_binwidth) || fd_binwidth <= 0) { rng <- diff(range(x_vals_non_na)) fd_binwidth <- if (is.finite(rng) && rng > 0) rng / 30 else 1 } hist_geom <- geom_histogram( binwidth = fd_binwidth, color = "gray40", fill = "gray80", na.rm = TRUE ) } caption_text <- paste0( "Mean = ", scales::number(mean_val, accuracy = 0.01), " | SD = ", scales::number(sd_val, accuracy = 0.01) ) p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[v]])) + hist_geom + annotate( "rect", xmin = mean_val - sd_val, xmax = mean_val + sd_val, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.12 ) + geom_vline( xintercept = mean_val, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.48 ) + # geom_vline( # xintercept = c(mean_val - sd_val, mean_val + sd_val), # color = "blue", # linetype = "dashed", # linewidth = 0.8 # ) + labs( title = paste("Histogram of", x_lab), x = x_lab, y = "Count", caption = caption_text ) + theme_minimal() + theme( plot.caption = element_text( hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 8) ), plot.caption.position = "plot" ) if (!is.na(nepal_value)) { p <- p + geom_vline( xintercept = nepal_value, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8 ) } p } ) walk(plots, print) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](sambit_files/figure-html/variable_plots-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](sambit_files/figure-html/variable_plots-2.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](sambit_files/figure-html/variable_plots-3.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](sambit_files/figure-html/variable_plots-4.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](sambit_files/figure-html/variable_plots-5.png){width=672} ::: ::: # Exposure-Outcome Scatterplots ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} scatter_plots <- histograms |> purrr::map(\(xy) { x_var <- xy[[1]] y_var <- xy[[2]] x_lab <- attr(df[[x_var]], "label") %||% x_var y_lab <- attr(df[[y_var]], "label") %||% y_var ggplot( df, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[y_var]]) ) + geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) + geom_smooth( method = "lm", formula = "y ~ x", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE ) + labs( title = paste0(y_lab, " vs ", x_lab), x = x_lab, y = y_lab ) + theme_minimal() }) purrr::walk(scatter_plots, print) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](sambit_files/figure-html/scatterplots-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_param <- function(draws, param, prior_sd = BETA_SD) { # the prior is Normal(0, prior_sd); show it out to 3 SDs either side ggplot(draws, aes(x = .data[[param]])) + stat_function( fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = 0, sd = prior_sd), color = "indianred3", linewidth = 1 ) + geom_density( fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.35, na.rm = TRUE ) + stat_pointinterval( aes(y = 0), point_interval = median_qi ) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3 * prior_sd, 3 * prior_sd)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + labs( title = param, x = param, y = "Density" ) } ``` ::: # Formal Model $$ \begin{align} YN_i &\sim \text{Normal}(\mu_i,\sigma) \\ \mu_i &= \alpha + \beta_{IU} IU_i + \beta_{IN} IN_i + \beta_{EA} EA_i + \beta_{UR} UR_i \\ \alpha &\sim \text{Normal}(50,25) \\ \beta_{IU} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,5) \\ \beta_{IN} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,5) \\ \beta_{EA} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,5) \\ \beta_{UR} &\sim \text{Normal}(0,5) \\ \sigma &\sim \text{Normal}(0,20), \quad \sigma > 0 \end{align} $$ | Variable | Description | Unit | |----------|-------------|------| | $YN_i$ | Youth not in Education, Employment, or Training | percentage | | $IU_i$ | Internet Users (%) | standardized | | $IN_i$ | GDP, per capita (PPP) | standardized | | $EA_i$ | Electricity Access (%) | standardized | | $UR_i$ | Urbanization (%) | standardized | #
